title: Battle of Cerrito
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cerrito", at revision 1370108780, opens: "The Battle of Cerrito, was a battle for the War of Independence of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, between the royalist forces who had control of the city of Montevideo and the rebel forces of the government of Buenos Aires." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870695, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1812 part of the Argentine War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
